verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM documents a built-in in-product agent: users start an agentic session with the @agent directive, and setup, tool-selection and usage guides are provided. The agent can be extended with no-code Agent Flows and code-based Agent Skills, so users can delegate tasks to it inside the product. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agent task delegation (community comments do not discuss the agent), and concrete documented examples of end-to-end delegated task completion; only one agent surface per chat session is documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
